notes: Agency is Georgia's SAMHSA Single State Agency (DBHDD); homepage and DBHDD program pages fetched and verified, phone is DBHDD's published 'Call Us Primary' number. Crisis: the Georgia Crisis & Access Line (GCAL, 1-800-715-4225, 24/7/365) is the single access point for Georgia's crisis system per the fetched DBHDD crisis-system page (GCAL also answers Georgia 988 calls; the separate mygcal.com fetch was blocked by research-tool rate limiting, so the verified DBHDD page is linked). Georgia 211 is delivered regionally by local United Ways — there is no single statewide GA 211 nonprofit site; the United Ways of Georgia homepage (fetched, verified) publishes Dial 211 as the statewide route (its dedicated /ga211 page returned 403 to the fetcher). Community Service Boards are the regional public behavioral-health providers covering all 159 counties (verified DBHDD finder). Georgia Council for Recovery (formerly Georgia Council on Substance Abuse) runs the CARES peer workforce; GMHCN runs the Peer2Peer Warm Line (888-945-1414) and is linked from DBHDD's crisis page. Georgia Medicaid (Dept. of Community Health) covers SUD services including MAT, detox and residential per the state plan, via the verified Medicaid hub.
